Compared on 2026-11-08: the main branch (old) and the rewrite (new)

QBase UI differences

Every scene of the visual run was captured in both editors, the same way, in light and dark and on desktop and phone. This page lists where the two differ so you can review them.

239scenes compared
201scenes with over 1% of pixels different
459texts only in the old editor
507texts only in the new editor
485measured values that differ
5scenes that failed in the new editor

Differences that are known and not listed as defects

  • The two editors open at different zoom levels (64% old, 80% new) and place the demo tables differently, so canvas pixels differ almost everywhere. Compare shapes and sizes in the pictures, not the pixel percentage.
  • Import parsing: the new editor keeps varchar(40), numeric(10, 2) and the UQ badge on a unique index; the old one drops them.
  • Not brought over by the owner's decision: the examples and templates pages, and the "Powered by" line.
  • The Tables list is in creation order in the old editor and alphabetical in the new one; the diagram title and the automatic layout also differ.
